deliveryMap.title: Delivery Map
deliveryMap.description: Map card data. Displayed through ShowDeliveryMap, not from this action.

estimated.title: Estimated
estimated.description: True if the driving time is a local estimate because the routing service was unavailable.

found.title: Found
found.description: True if a matching order was located for this email and order number.

identityLocked.title: Identity Locked
identityLocked.description: True once this conversation is pinned to a verified email.

inTransit.title: In Transit
inTransit.description: True only when the order is shipped and has a reported position.

locationAge.title: Location Age
locationAge.description: How long ago the position was reported, in words.

message.title: Message
message.description: Spoken answer with distance, driving time and how old the position is - safe to read to the caller as-is. Contains no link and no coordinates.

orderNumber.title: Order Number
orderNumber.description: The matched order number, used to chain ShowDeliveryMap.

verifiedEmail.title: Verified Email
verifiedEmail.description: The email that matched this lookup. Empty when nothing matched.
